Market today: The 10-year Treasury yield hitting a 2002 high is the big driver, pushing rates up and potentially pressuring growth/tech names. Tech sentiment is mixed, with some analysts bullish on MSFT but others warning about AI risks.

Your holdings: SOXL (-27.23%) and SPAL (-15.98%) are still in the SELL zone and need attention. They are leveraged and decaying, and your margin amplifies the pain.

Watch: Microsoft's AI future (Headline 8 & 10) and the broader tech sentiment around AI (Headline 7).

Bottom line: Focus on managing your leveraged tech positions and watching for any clear catalysts in your core holdings.
plays: SOXL: Consider trimming exposure if it continues to slide towards your stop.
SPAL: Similar to SOXL, watch the downside closely and consider trimming if it breaks key levels.
